associations.rationale: The formal type directly states or defines the item: A property of an object in a category with zero morphisms that supplies epimorphism witnesses and entails projectivity.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: For each object, the property supplies existential data whose final morphism is an epimorphism.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: The projectivity structure carried by an object satisfying this property.
The formal type directly states or defines the item: A property characterized by projectivity and epimorphic coproduct desc morphisms.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: Projectivity together with epimorphic coproduct desc morphisms characterizes this property.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: Every object satisfying this property is a separator.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: Every object satisfying this property is projective.
